title: Re: Abadunkadunkaddonna
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 5A: Love Handles, Backfat, and Hunched Shoulders. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 5A: Love Handles, Backfat, and Hunched Shoulders. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Abadunkadunkaddonna has turned back up and has been talking mad smack about you to anyone that will listen. She has been calling for a dance off, but not to worry, there is no chance that the King's Board of Trustees is going to let you dance. They have seen how you move and how you shrug off rhythm and timing like bad habits and they don't plan on sending you in to represent Townston in a dance off anytime soon.

I just want you to go back into Storeroom 5A take out some of those peanut-sized half-pint Abba Labbas and Abadunkadunkaddonna. Nothing special. When you are done with that return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

You have taken down Abadunkadunkaddonna again, have you? Way to go! Let me know if you want to try again. Consider it practice.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Client level range: 43–46
